Wave and vibration attenuation via full band gaps in 3D periodic sandwich metapanels

Sales, M. B. M.; Araujo, B. C. C.; Santos, M. C. P.; Pereira, F. N.; Miranda Jr., E. J. P.

Journal of the Brazilian Society of Mechanical Sciences and Engineering · v. 48 · 309

Ver publicação ↗

Abstract

The study analyses wave propagation and vibration attenuation in three-dimensional periodic sandwich metapanels. The proposed architecture uses embedded resonant features to modify the dispersion characteristics and promote full bandgaps, providing a route for controlling structural vibrations over a broad frequency range.
